about: Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal's binding for mods (docs/port/MODS.md, sections 4 and 11): its hook points. sdk/tools/gen_binding.py writes port/game/rac3/script_binding.c, sdk/include/openrac/games/rac3.hpp and sdk/types/rac3.d.luau from it, with every hook point's permanent id and aliases (rac3.ids.lock); --check holds the hook points to the hook rows of port/game/rac3-<disc>/libraries.tsv. Symbols are each disc's: PAL first, where the ids are anchored (its level functions by the level catalogue's names, one function in every level), NTSC-U as port/tools/hostgen/release_carry_rac3.py carries PAL's rows. An id reuses Going Commando's <area>.<name> for the same job (openrac-mods docs/MULTI_GAME.md).

hooks.name: Hero_TakeDamage
hooks.about: Takes a hit's points from the hero's health (the s32 at 0x001A7430, hero +0x2850), scaled by the armour's factor and the help measure's, at least 1 and never below 0 (hero_damage); the hero's hit reaction calls it for each hit. Going Commando's rac2.player.take_damage.

hooks.name: Item_Give
hooks.about: Gives the player item id (item_give): its owned and new bytes (0x00142CA0, 0x00142D40, a byte per item), its row's starting ammo to a gun that has none, the vendor's list (Vendor_StockAdd) and the quick select. Givers, purchases and each level's start (Level_GiveItems) go through it.

hooks.name: Item_Upgrade
hooks.about: The vendor's Mega upgrade of item id (weapon_buy_mega): its level set to 5, its ammo filled, its experience cleared. The vendor calls it after the price is paid; a replacement can carry out its own upgrade.

hooks.name: Weapon_LevelUp
hooks.about: Steps weapon id to its next level (weapon_level_up): its row (the item's byte at 0x001425C0) moves along the row's +0x46, its experience is raised to the old row's step and its ammo filled. A replacement that does not call the original blocks the step.

hooks.name: Weapon_TakeAmmo
hooks.about: Takes rounds of a gun's ammo (ammo_use; item -1: the one in hand): 1 when there were enough, 0 otherwise; always 1 for a gun without a maximum. Every gun calls it as it fires. Rac1's TakeAmmo.

hooks.name: Weapon_AddAmmo
hooks.about: Adds rounds to a gun's ammo (ammo_add, the words at 0x001427F0), capped at its row's maximum (+0x8A); returns what did not fit. Ammo pickups and the vendor call it.

hooks.name: Vendor_Price
hooks.about: The price in bolts of the vendor's row under the cursor (vendor_price): the gun's (+0x7C of its row), its level-5 row's for a Mega row, 9/10 of it with the discount. The vendor's screen and the purchase both ask it.

hooks.name: Vendor_BuildList
hooks.about: Fills the vendor's weapons rows from its stock (vendor_weapon_list): a rounds row for each owned gun that is not full, a special row, a row for each gun for sale (Mega rows in challenge mode), and keeps the cursor on its item. The vendor calls it as it opens and after a purchase.

hooks.name: Vendor_StockAdd
hooks.about: Lists item id for the vendor (vendor_stock_add; vendor_stock at 0x001D54D8, a u16 per entry: the item, bit 15 owned, bit 14 not yet for sale). Item_Give calls it.

hooks.name: Moby_RecordDeath
hooks.about: An enemy's death (moby_killed): its class's experience to the gun that killed it (by its damage record), the hero's experience and its bolt drop (Bolt_SpawnPickups). Enemies call it as they die. Going Commando's rac2.moby.record_death.

hooks.name: Moby_PostHit
hooks.about: Queues a damage record (a game address) for moby victim in the hit ring (damage_queue; 0x001EED00, 64 entries): a moby keeps one pending (+0xA8), which a hit at least as strong replaces and a weaker one only adds its flags to. The guns and the shock mod call it. Going Commando's rac2.combat.post_hit.

hooks.name: Bolt_SpawnPickups
hooks.about: Spawns a burst of bolt coins from moby (bolts_drop): an amount from low to high split into the biggest coins that fit, each made by Bolt_SpawnPickup; flag 8 at most maximum coins (the rest banked, 0x0014269C). Enemies' drops (Moby_Killed) and the levels' scripted bursts come here. A replacement can change low and high, or make the coins itself.

hooks.name: Bolt_SpawnPickup
hooks.about: Makes one bolt coin worth value at position with velocity (game addresses of four floats each) from source (bolt_coin_spawn): its moby, or 0; 64 units or more from the camera the value is banked instead.

hooks.name: Bolt_Collect
hooks.about: A bolt coin collected (bolt_pickup_collect): its value added to the player's bolts (0x00142660), the bolt HUD shown for 180 frames and its sparkle. The coin's update calls it as it reaches the hero. A replacement can add more with openrac_api.bolts.

hooks.name: Level_Load
hooks.about: The way to the next level (level_load, each level's copy): picks the transition for the level asked for, sets level_current (0x001D545C) and starts reading its files. Going Commando's rac2.level.load.

hooks.name: Level_GiveItems
hooks.about: A level's start (give_level_items): the standing items (the suit, the camera options, the thruster-pack) through Item_Give, then the level's own. Every level calls it as it starts.

hooks.name: Hero_DeathDone
hooks.about: The hero's death over (hero_death_done: state 57 ended, or a fall out of the level): the death counted in the stats and the respawn asked for (0x001A71D2), which the level carries out at the end of the frame.

hooks.name: Hero_Update
hooks.about: The hero's whole update each frame (hero_tick), from the level's frame in play (gameplay_update, game mode 0) after every moby's update (moby_update_all) and before the frame's draw: the pad, his state machine and movement, ledges, his collision and animation and the camera's copy of him. Florana (level 2) and levels 4, 8, 9 and 27 have copies of their own; together they are one hook point over the 34 story levels. While he is in another body (hero +0x25E4 not 0) it runs rac3.player.update_character in place of its own steps. Going Commando's rac2.player.update.

hooks.name: Hero_UpdateCharacter
hooks.about: The hero's update while he is in another body (hero +0x25E4: 1 Clank, 2 Clank in Holostar Studios, 3 a disguise such as the Tyhrra-Guise, 5 Qwark in the vid-comics): rac3.player.update calls it each frame in place of its own steps, for that body's moby, state, collision and animation. Levels 2 and 9, level 23 and the vid-comics (30 to 36) have copies of their own; together they are one hook point over the 34 story levels.

hooks.name: Hero_SetAnimation
hooks.about: Starts a hero animation (hero_anim_set): sequence from keyframe start_key, blended in from the pose he is in over blend ticks (negative: a blend curve, -1 is 11 ticks, -2 is 16). In a disguise (hero +0x25E4 is 3) the sequence goes through rac3.player.remap_animation first. The hero's states call it.

hooks.name: Hero_RemapAnimation
hooks.about: The body's sequence for a hero animation (hero_guise_anim_remap) on the disguise classes 0x1A4E and 0x173B (the class of the hero's moby, its +0xAA); any other class gets the animation back. rac3.player.set_animation calls it while he wears a disguise (hero +0x25E4 is 3).

hooks.name: Hero_SwitchItem
hooks.about: What the hero holds in a hand slot (hero_item_switch; slot 0 is his hand): Square brings out the wrench, Circle (or R1 where the settings say R1 fires) the equipped gun, L2 and R2 with the wrench out the gun with its lock-on mod. The hero's states call it each frame; a replacement that does not call the original keeps what he holds.

hooks.name: Hud_DrawMarkers
hooks.about: Draws a player's screen markers (reticle_markers_draw, the levels' copy of the front end's), the ones queued this frame with reticle_marker_add (func_L01_003F6F20 on PAL), from the frame's draw after the level's update; with one view (0x001D6698 is 0) it then empties the queue. The 34 story levels.
